selection: Whole v0.4.6 design-system leaf files MediaContrastPalette.kt, AppPopupSurface.kt, AppSemanticVisualPolicy.kt, AppEntryIconPalette.kt and AppChromeSizeTokens.kt, plus the original AppEntryIconPaletteTest.kt. Part A of roadmap slice fnd-design-system-leaf-completion.
purpose: Emit the complete v0.4.6 files verbatim from the existing component producer (extract-upstream-components.py). Three direct-mode v0.2.5 copies are excluded in prepareUpstreamSources; AppChromeSizeTokens advances the v0.4.0 copy the component chain already emits; AppEntryIconPalette is new. Nothing is adapted and no consumer is re-pinned (consumer rule): features re-pin to v0.4.6 when their own slice runs.

componentChainPredecessors.predecessor: the vendored v0.2.5 file read by extract-upstream-components.py (no earlier layer touches it)
desktop/upstream-slices/v040-chrome-actions/AppChromeSizeTokens.kt (v0.4.0, emitted by the same chain; its direct-mode exclude already exists)

behaviourChanges: MediaContrastPalette gains SecondaryForeground, ControlSurface, ControlScrim, Track, Success, Warning, Error and Rating (the v0.2.5 object only had Foreground and Scrim); the carried v042-player-readability TopControlBar already reads Error and Warning.
AppPopupSurface resolves the default content colour through AppContentColors.primaryText() instead of MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurface.
AppChromeSizeTokens gains LiquidSearchFieldHeightDp = 40; the native search metrics are unchanged.
AppSemanticVisualPolicy differs from v0.2.5 in KDoc comments only; its declarations are byte-for-byte the same code.
AppEntryIconPalette (sixteen entry icon colours, cursor and ProvideAppEntryIconColors) is new; nothing consumes it until the settings entry slices land.
notCarried: AppChromeSizeTokensTest.kt: byte-identical to the v0.4.0 copy that v040-chrome-actions already emits into the original chrome action test root.

AppSemanticVisualPolicyTest.kt and AppIconStylePolicyTest.kt: byte-identical to the v0.2.5 copies and emitted by no producer today; the first reads app source files by relative path, so neither is added here.

design-system/.../AppPreferenceComponents.kt, AppSelectionPreferenceComponents.kt, AppCard.kt, AppDesktopInteraction.kt, AppTonalPillTabPolicy.kt and DampedDragAnimation.kt: part B of the roadmap slice (Windows adapters, hash-pinned recipes).
